text:
sam_sales: handoff for 'Harvest & Co' (mid-market retail). Demo went well but they hit intermittent 500s on long invoices during live test. Renewal: 2026-03-01. Cost sensitivity: asked if we can reduce run cost ~15% with committed capacity. Also requested SAML SSO and a short private-eval window in Feb.

sam_sales: example curl (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \
 -d '{"model":"redwood-large-1","prompt":"<long invoice + context>","max_tokens":1100}'\
# -> HTTP 500, x-request-id: req_b7c9d2f1
```

jamie_cs: i'll run the onboarding kickoff (owner). @oliver_cs_manager will draft capacity/pricing scenarios. @maya_support please triage the 500s and add findings to INF-4210. @kevin_eng can you check kernel/kv cache OOMs and propose fallback rules?

ops-bot: INF-4210 created by maya_support (P2) https://issues.redwood.dev/INF-4210

maya_support: repro in staging produced "kernel_launch_failed" and a CUDA OOM. attached logs to INF-4210. temp workaround: reducing max_tokens to 800 removed the error in staging.

kevin_eng: noted. i'll propose a short-term routing fallback to redwood-medium-1 for sequences >1024 and a longer-term kv cache tuning. creating PR and will link.

jamie_cs: action items:
- Kickoff (jamie_cs) Mon 9am PT (include customer SSO contact).
- Triage & logs (maya_support) EOD.
- Eng mitigation (kevin_eng) 48h for fallback rule + memo.
- Pricing (oliver_cs_manager) Tue COB with 3 scenarios + private eval cost.

sam_sales: shared demo + contract: https://files.redwood.example/harvest-handoff (cs/eng access). please update INF-4210 and CS-5012. ping me for exec escalation.

jamie_cs: capturing feedback for enablement deck: "predictable latency on long invoices", "prefer committed discount", "SSO required pre-prod". closing thread until kickoff scheduled. :lock:
